import glob

        script_name = os.path.basename(script_path)
        start_time = time.time()

        end_time = time.time()
        results[script_name] = end_time - start_time
    return results

import pandas as pd
def task_func(script_path, output_file_path):
    result = subprocess.run(script_path, shell=True, capture_output=True)
    if result.returncode != 0:
        raise ValueError("Script execution failed")
    try:
        df = pd.read_csv(output_file_path)
    except Exception:
        raise ValueError("Invalid CSV")
    if df.shape[1] != 2:
        raise ValueError("CSV does not contain exactly 2 columns")
    import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
    ax = df.plot.bar(x=df.columns[0], y=df.columns[1], legend=False)
    plt.xlabel(df.columns[0])
    plt.ylabel(df.columns[1])
    plt.title("Bar Graph")
    return df, ax
